vignette: A young permanent molar with an incompletely formed root has deep caries and only brief sensitivity to cold. It is diagnosed with reversible pulpitis. A small pulp exposure occurs during caries removal.
stem: Which approach is most appropriate for controlling bleeding before placing the capping material?

options.text: Direct pulp capping after sodium hypochlorite irrigation for hemostasis
Direct pulp capping after saline irrigation for hemostasis
No vital pulp therapy, because an immature root rules out pulp capping
No vital pulp therapy, because a tooth with reversible pulpitis is not considered vital
